summary: Replace AI upload card system with freeform text box

comments.content:
Right now you can upload any one of many predefined laws into AI with very
limited customizability.

Suggest removing the cards and simply allowing the current laws present in
the AI to be edited; the AI upload machine presents a freeform multiline
textbox allowing whatever laws the user likes to be specified.

I think this is the way setting new AI upload laws should have been from the start.

Great potential.

This sounds like an awesome plan, buuuut the three laws should still be hardcoded I
think (or very very much harder to change). Give the AI computer, say, 6 slots (0-5)
and have a "Slot 0", "Slot 4", and "Slot 5" card that are just freeform text boxes.

See also issue 137
http://code.google.com/p/ss13/issues/detail?id=137

this idea is bad, everything you can do with it is either retarded or can be achieved
with commands + "only X is human"
